leadText:
Rubello Town (Japanese: ルイボスタウン Rooibos Town) is an -exclusive location in Hoenn. It is located somewhere between Littleroot Town and Fortree City. Like many other in the region, it has a Contest Hall.

 and arrived at Rubello Town in A Fan with a Plan. There, they saw a poster for a Pokémon Contest slated to be held soon. noticed the R1 sign on the poster, which they later learned from Nurse Joy that in order to enter the Rubello Contest, a must have obtained at least one Ribbon.

 
Also in the Pokémon Center was Drew, being mobbed by a group of women calling themselves the Mothers for Pokémon, all of whom wanted his autograph because they were huge fans of his. One of them, named Savannah, recognized from the Contest and befriended her. Later, the group went grocery shopping with Savannah and her daughter Sandra.

After shopping, the group had dinner, and Savannah—who was also entering the Rubello Contest—informed May that the competition would follow the Grand Festival rules, meaning that contestants would be required to switch between the Performance Stage and the Battle Stage.

The Rubello Contest took place in Cruisin' for a Losin. In the first round, May performed with , Drew used his , and Savannah selected her . The three of them were able to impress the panel of judges and, along with Sonny, advance to the Battle Stage.

Drew made quick work of Sonny, using his to defeat his , and advanced to the finals. May, on the other hand, had trouble during her battle with Savannah, since her suffered from as she was competing in a Pokémon Contest for the first time. Bulbasaur ended up losing to Savannah's , but May wanted to win so badly that she pushed Bulbasaur even after the judges had ruled . For this, she was scolded by the Chief of the Pokémon Activities Committee, Raoul Contesta.

In the final round, Drew went up against Savannah. When time ran out, the scoreboard showed that Drew had more points. As a result, Vivian announced Drew as the winner of the R1 Rubello Town Pokémon Contest. This victory gave Drew his fourth Contest Ribbon, bringing him one step closer to the Hoenn Grand Festival.
